notes.title: Weapons update
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the latest update to our game, with features to enhance your experience. Players can now enjoy:

[b]Free Weapons: [/b]One of the most asked-for features for Mechstorm was the ability to fire weapons whether they are targeted or not. Weapons can now fire freely based on the camera's direction.

[b]Advanced Targeting System:[/b] We have added a context-sensitive targeting reticle to support free-fire weapons. When there is an auto-target object, the reticule focuses there. Otherwise, it indicates the point in the world where the weapon will do damage.

[b]Controller Support for Puzzles:[/b] The puzzle now has controller support. The beginning of the game still needs keyboard support.

Next steps: The next steps for the Mechstorm team will be weapon damage to the world, a new demo level layout, health powerups, and new narrative videos.

Dive into the game now and experience these exciting enhancements!

notes.title: Vapor Run is Now Mech Storm
notes.content:
[b]More Co-Op Combat[/b]

We're thrilled to bring you exciting news about the evolution of our co-op vehicle combat game. After gathering valuable feedback, we're making some changes to the focus of our game. [i]Vapor Run[/i] is undergoing a transformation and emerging as the fierce co-op robot fighting gam "[i]Mech Storm[/i]"!

In [i]Mech Storm[/i], the world has plunged into chaos, with humans being driven underground by an unstoppable robotic army and a malevolent AI hell-bent on eradicating our kind. As humanity's last hope, you and a fellow player will work together, locked in an epic battle for survival against overwhelming odds. Embrace the adrenaline-pumping experience of cooperative robot warfare as you strategize, upgrade, and triumph over the forces that seek to make us extinct.

[b]Key Features:[/b]

[list]

[*]Co-op Robot Fighting: Engage in thrilling cooperative battles with a friend or team up with players from around the world. Together, you'll forge an unbreakable bond to combat the robotic menace, sharing resources, tactics, and victory.

[*]Devastating Vehicles: Command an arsenal of formidable vehicles, each with unique abilities and customizable features. Discover your preferred playstyle and equip your mechanized warriors with powerful weapons, armor, and specialized gear to dominate the battlefield.

[*]Epic Campaign: Immerse yourself in an immersive storyline as you delve into the depths of a post-apocalyptic world. Unravel the mysteries surrounding the evil AI, uncover its sinister plans, and unite humanity in a grand quest to restore peace and reclaim our future.

[*]Challenging Missions: Face off against relentless hordes of robotic enemies in a variety of meticulously crafted missions. From pulse-pounding assaults to tactical defenses, each encounter will test your skills, teamwork, and resilience to the fullest.

[*]Innovative Progression: Earn experience, unlock new abilities, and enhance your mechs to become an unstoppable force. Discover rare schematics, upgrade modules, and advanced technologies to gain a competitive edge and push back the forces of darkness.

[*]Continuous Updates: Brace yourselves for a relentless stream of fresh content, including new mechs, missions, events, and gameplay features. The battle against the robot army never ends, and we'll be right there with you, ensuring an ever-evolving experience.
[/list]

Prepare yourselves, Mech Storm warriors, for a battle that will reshape the future of human survival. play alone or with a friend, gear up combat vehicles, and join the resistance against the encroaching forces of darkness. It's time to rise from the ashes, unite in common purpose, and show the world that humanity's spirit cannot be extinguished!

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to embark on an unforgettable co-op robot fighting adventure when Mech Storm arrives. Together, we will prevail!

The Mech Storm Development Team
